verdicts.reason: A is clean, with no collisions and readable text, but it breaks the original's signature move: the headline no longer sits on the red T. The T is pushed off to the right edge as a separate shape, the text block is small for the banner, and a wide dead zone is left on the left. B keeps the layered T-behind-text identity with the first line on the red bar, as in the original, but 'JOIN VOLUNTEERING NOW!' wraps and leaves 'NOW!' alone on its own line. B also leaves large empty blue areas on both sides, so it is faithful but still needs polish.
